verdicts.reason: Candidate A is broken. The headline's wrapped 'week' runs into the subhead ('audio coaching'). The legal text is jammed directly under the subhead, and the yearly card's 'per year' spills out of its dark card as cream text on a light background, so it can't be read. The headline is also small, so it doesn't stand out over the cards. Candidate B has a strong, clean headline and a clear CTA with no collisions, but it has real faults. The price cards are shrunk so far that the plan names and 'per month/year' labels can't be read. The cards are reordered to 6/80/48, which breaks the original Monthly-Yearly-Family order and moves the featured yearly plan off-centre. The subhead and legal text are crammed into a tiny block at the right edge.
